title: ESP32-simple_cycle_counter: an LED duty-cycle counter
description: An ESP32 program that drives the on-board LED (GPIO 2) through rising and then falling duty cycles in software, counting the cycles. Written in C with ESP-IDF and FreeRTOS, in VS Code with PlatformIO, at the Universidade de Brasília with Prof. Jones Yudi Mori Alves da Silva.

contributors.name: Mori Alves da Silva, Jones Yudi
